# Vendored editor

Decap CMS 3.17.1, downloaded from the npm registry package decap-cms@3.17.1.
Package SHA-1: f300a2940df67c15414bf95061be3f00e76004f3.
Source and MIT license: https://github.com/decaporg/decap-cms
Included decap-cms.js.LICENSE.txt contains bundled dependency license notices.

Upgrade deliberately and retest the editor theme and content schemas before deployment.
